private_design: Construct factorized sign, integer/leading-dot mantissa, fraction, and exponent productions with @mkbabb/parse-that/core all/any/regex plus Parser.opt/map. Because 1.0.0 aggregate failures restore offsets but not predecessor values, locally wrap the reachable aggregate with public ParserState.save/restore through Parser; do not read src or assign offset. No whole-number regex or dispatch.
